title: You don't need a church building to obey Jesus.
paragraphs: You don't need a church building to obey Jesus.
You need a willing heart.
For years, many believers have believed the same lie...
"I'll start making disciples when I have more time."
"When I have more money."
"When I know the Bible better."
"When I have a ministry."
But Jesus never said...
"Wait until you're ready."
He said:
"Go and make disciples..." (Matthew 28:19-20)

If you've been waiting for the "perfect time," this book will lovingly challenge that mindset and show you that God can use your living room, your dining table, your lunch break, and your everyday life for His Kingdom.

House Church Made Simple
A Step-by-Step Guide to Starting a Biblical House Church with a Busy Schedule and Zero Budget

This practical, Scripture-centered guide will help you discover that ordinary believers can build extraordinary disciple-making communities—without a church building, a large budget, or a full-time ministry.
This isn't about creating another program.
It's about returning to the simplicity of the New Testament church.
Inside You'll Discover:
✅ How to start a biblical house church even if you work full-time
✅ The simple New Testament model for disciple-making
✅ Why you don't need a building, stage, or expensive equipment
✅ How to lead Bible discussions with confidence
✅ A step-by-step guide for your first gathering
✅ How to raise future leaders instead of creating followers
✅ Practical ways to multiply healthy house churches
✅ Common mistakes that stop churches from growing—and how to avoid them
🔥 Most People vs. Few People
Most people wait for permission.
Few people simply obey Jesus.
Most people think ministry belongs inside church buildings.
Few people understand that every home can become a place of worship, prayer, and discipleship.
Most people make excuses.
Few people make disciples.
Which one will you be?
